name: Sec Carbon, Limited
summary: SEC Carbon, Limited, formed in 1934 with headquarters in Amagasaki, Japan, makes and supplies graphite electrodes mainly for steel production, along with SK-B graphitized cathode blocks used in aluminum smelting. It also provides carbon and graphite materials for the semiconductor, aerospace, chemical, machinery and metal industries. Formerly SEC Corporation, it has used its present name since October 2006.
